description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Runtime_GetIncludePath, which manages include paths, caches, and resolves file paths for the Smarty templating engine. It contains methods for checking include path updates, retrieving include directories, and resolving include files.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_GetIncludePath
classes.description: Manages and resolves include paths within the Smarty template engine environment, with caching mechanisms for efficiency.

methods.name: isNewIncludePath
methods.description: Checks if the include path has been updated and refreshes internal caches accordingly.

methods.name: getIncludePathDirs
methods.description: Returns the current list of include directory paths.

methods.name: getIncludePath
methods.description: Resolves the full file path for a given filename within specified include directories.
